response.sql: WITH per_race AS (SELECT r.name AS name, AVG(ds.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(*) AS field_size FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId GROUP BY r.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(field_size) AS avg_field FROM per_race) SELECT AVG(p.avg_points) AS avg_of_avg_points, AVG(p.field_size) AS avg_field_size, AVG(p.field_size - o.avg_field) AS avg_excess_over_overall FROM per_race p, overall o WHERE p.field_size > o.avg_field
